recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if BR&R separately decides that ResearchStudy.progressStatus.state needs an explicit unknown or blank study-state concept.
issue_request: FHIR-28464 asked for a value representing unknown statuses because ResearchStudy.status is required and incoming clinical trial status may be unknown or blank. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution accepted this as part of shifting ResearchStudy.status to publication status.
initial_application: A commit that explicitly mentions #28464, 9175459a6e, did not change the status element. The actual status semantics shift appears in d5448ea900, where ResearchStudy.status changed from current study state bound to research-study-status to publication state bound to publication-status, whose codes include unknown.
additional_context: ResearchStudy is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The old research-study-status terminology remains in the current build for ResearchStudy.progressStatus.state rather than the required resource status. Later Jira FHIR-50644 confirms BR&R's interpretation that ResearchStudy.status is publication status and trial lifecycle status belongs in progressStatus.state.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current required ResearchStudy.status binding already includes unknown through PublicationStatus, and adding unknown to research-study-status would not address the required status element after the R5 shift.

related_jiras.note: Broader ClinicalTrials.gov ResearchStudy work whose source commit shifted ResearchStudy.status to publication status.
Later Resolved - No Change decision confirming ResearchStudy.status is publication status and study lifecycle status is represented through progressStatus.state.
